correctness.rationale: For every projective R in characteristic three, Q_R has partials equal to (bz-cy)^3,(cx-az)^3,(ay-bx)^3; the two-dimensional linear ideal generated by these forms has cubed complete intersection, so the saturated Jacobian has length 9 and local algebra k[[u,v]]/(u^3,v^3), not I_R^3. On the stated c=1 open Δ=(a³−a)(b−b³)((a³−a)²−(b−b³)²)≠0, independent symbolic expansion gives B u³+A v³+u³v−uv³, transformed to A w³+(s−s³)u⁴+u³w−u w³, s³=−B/A. The coprime (3,4) Newton edge forces one cusp branch; Bézout excludes additional components and projection from R proves rationality/delta3. All smooth tangents contain S=Frob(R), which is smooth and distinct; projection from S is inseparable of degree3, giving divisor S+3T for smooth T≠S. Degree-four base-point space has dimension6 and its six-jet evaluation matrix has rank5 on the open (minor −ab), so the quartic is unique there. A source script was read line-by-line; independent SymPy symbolic checks reproduced gradient, local and tangent identities, not merely source VERIFY_OK.
